Initial release of SmartFolder - an intelligent file organization assistant for OpenClaw.

- Organize, analyze, and clean up your file system using natural language commands.
- Supports intelligent categorization, duplicate detection, bulk renaming, disk analysis, and automated cleanup workflows.
- Provides safety features including dry-run mode, confirmation prompts, undo logs, and trash support.
- Optional ffmpeg support for enhanced media file handling.
- Includes detailed usage examples and configuration options.
